title: Leeds Castle
identityStatus: Exact-QID castle relation, current separate named-component footprints, original courtyard and island traces

controls.basis: Attributed exact-QID relation6941053 and current separately mapped footprints, service routes, walls and island. Historic England describes two islands, D-shaped Gloriette with courtyard, two pointed arches under the covered bridge, octagonal New Castle turrets and present two-storey Maidens Tower/gatehouse. Metric heights, roof sections, aperture sections and water/bailey datum are original photographic estimates; no surveyed numeric heights verified.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: Native +X east,+Z south; original NE/SW authoring-axis rotation is baked into vertices, runtime heading0.
nativeAxes.origin: Horizontal exact-QID map anchor. Y0 is provisional visible moat plane; island/bailey floorY4.4. Water surface and natural terrain belong to host.

reconstruction.scope: Current New Castle and octagonal front towers, D-shaped hollow Gloriette, two-storey covered bridge with two real pointed arches, Maidens Tower and bath arches, southwest gatehouse with open mapped passage, low island curtain/bastions, stone entrance bridge and current fragmentary barbican.
reconstruction.basis: Original deterministic geometry from attributed OSM traces, Historic England architectural descriptions and castle-operator exterior/aerial photographs. No copied mesh, photographic texture or reproduced printed plan.
reconstruction.referenceState: Current exterior. Fairfax Courtyard, parkland, detached service buildings, gardens, interiors and full outer barbican archaeology are separate or excluded.
